title: AMD Instinct MI50/MI60 and Radeon VII (gfx906) on an ARM host
examples: Instinct MI50 32GB on an RK3588 board

inference.summary: llama.cpp with Vulkan (Mesa RADV, arm64 packages, no ROCm needed); HIP only after Vulkan works.
inference.notes: Boards with non-coherent PCIe (RK3588) need a host kernel with amdgpu built and the write-combined GTT patch, and a BAR0 small enough for the PCIe window: shrink it to 256 MiB with resizable BAR (scripts/amd_vbios.py says whether this card's VBIOS can). For HIP: ROCm 6.3.3 built from source for gfx906, with HSA_USERPTR_FOR_PAGED_MEM=0 on non-coherent hosts. The mi50-arm guide has the kernel, ROCm and Proxmox steps; docs/PROXMOX.md runs OmniCortex in a container there.

retraining.summary: PyTorch on the ARM CPU: there are no PyTorch ROCm wheels for aarch64.
retraining.notes: Train small LoRAs on the CPU or on another computer, and serve the result here through Vulkan.

notes: Untested on real hardware: the steps follow the mi50-arm guide, which is itself untested on an MI50.
author: OmniCortex
